title: Gem Smashers
sources: own knowledge of the game (facts written for this def)
notes: Genre: Puzzle. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: A bouncing gem-ball style game: keep the hero bouncing and smash every gem block in the room.
widgets.label: How it plays

widgets.text: Plain gems break in one hit, tougher blocks need several, some only break with power-ups.
widgets.label: Block types

widgets.text: Boss rooms end each world: hit the weak spot during the opening.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Themed worlds of short rooms, with a boss at the end.
widgets.label: Structure

widgets.text: Power-ups change the bounce or the smash strength for a while.
widgets.label: Power-ups

widgets.text: Collect the gems in every room to complete a world.
widgets.label: Collect

widgets.text: Clear every world's rooms and boss.
widgets.label: Goal
